summary.tldr: Adds Criminal Code rules for long-term care facility owners and officers who fail to provide residents with the necessaries of life.
what_it_does: Creates a Criminal Code offence for owners and officers of long-term care facilities who fail to ensure residents get the necessaries of life.
Defines long-term care facilities and officers for this rule, covering facilities for three or more adults who need care because of age, illness, mental disorder, disability or frailty.
Lets courts ban convicted owners or officers from jobs or volunteer roles that put them in charge of, or in a position of trust over, vulnerable adults.
Requires courts to consider any provincial penalty or protective measure when deciding on that ban.
Adds an organisation’s failure to meet a legal duty owed to vulnerable adults as an aggravating factor at sentencing.
Sets the bill to come into force 30 days after royal assent.
